cmd.aiSetup: Quick Git: Connect AI tool to review
cfg.aiGuard.enabled: Watches the project and warns when an AI tool changes files with risks (secrets, .env, CI, dangerous commands).
cfg.aiGuard.quietSeconds: Seconds after the last file change before the AI Guard checks for risks and warns right away (default 3).
cfg.aiGuard.commitGate: Warns before committing when the changes contain risks.
cfg.animations: Animations and visual effects in the Quick Git panel. Turn off for light mode (faster on slower computers).
